pharm: 19-nortestosterone derivative; androgen receptor agonist with predominant anabolic activity
quick: 50-100 mg deep IM every 1-4 weeks (anemia of CKD); osteoporosis-related historically 50 mg q3wk
Used in anemia of renal failure; monitor
Hb/Hct, LFTs, lipids, virilization, growth in children
summary: Nandrolone decanoate is a long-acting injectable anabolic steroid historically used for anemia of chronic kidney disease, certain catabolic states, and (in some regions) osteoporosis. It promotes nitrogen retention and erythropoiesis. It is a controlled substance with significant misuse potential and androgenic adverse effects.
indications: Management of anemia of chronic renal insufficiency (erythropoiesis stimulation)
Catabolic / wasting conditions to improve nitrogen balance (region-dependent)
Adjunct in selected osteoporosis (historical use, region-dependent)

dosage.d: Adults: 50-200 mg per week or commonly 100-200 mg/week; women: 50-100 mg/week
Dose by weight per specialist; monitor bone maturation

admin: Administer by deep intramuscular injection, preferably gluteal
Warm vial to room temperature; use oil-based depot technique with aspiration before injecting
Rotate injection sites; do not give IV
Confirm not pregnant before use in women
Obtain baseline Hb/Hct, LFTs, and lipids
moa: Binds the androgen receptor to stimulate gene transcription that increases protein synthesis and nitrogen retention, promoting muscle and tissue anabolism. It stimulates erythropoietin production and red cell mass, and modestly increases bone mineralization. The 19-nor structure gives a higher anabolic-to-androgenic ratio than testosterone.

absolute: Known or suspected prostate or male breast carcinoma
Carcinoma of the breast in women with hypercalcemia
Hypersensitivity to the drug or vehicle (oil)
relative: Cardiac, renal, or hepatic impairment (fluid retention)

preg: Contraindicated. Androgens cause virilization of a female fetus (clitoromegaly, abnormal genital development). Exclude pregnancy before initiating in women of childbearing potential.
lact: Contraindicated. Not recommended during breastfeeding due to potential virilization and adverse effects on the infant.
renal: A primary use is anemia of chronic renal failure; can cause sodium and fluid retention worsening edema. Use cautiously and monitor fluid status, blood pressure, and hematocrit.
hepatic: Can cause hepatic dysfunction, cholestatic jaundice, and rarely peliosis hepatis or hepatic neoplasms with prolonged use. Contraindicated in severe hepatic disease; monitor liver function.

major: Warfarin and other anticoagulants (enhanced effect, bleeding risk - reduce dose and monitor INR)
Insulin and oral hypoglycemics (may alter glucose control)
minor: May alter thyroid function test results (decreased thyroxine-binding globulin)
interactions.food: Not applicable for the injection; ensure adequate dietary protein and calories for anabolic effect
interactions.diagnostics: May decrease thyroxine-binding globulin and total T4; alters lipid panel (lowers HDL); can affect clotting factor and metyrapone tests

serious: Virilization in women (deepening voice, hirsutism, clitoromegaly - may be irreversible)

monitoring: Signs of virilization in women and children
Prostate exam and PSA in older men
Blood glucose in diabetics; fluid status / blood pressure
counsel: This is a controlled anabolic steroid; do not misuse for performance or bodybuilding
Women: report voice changes, facial hair, or menstrual changes immediately (may be permanent)
Report jaundice, dark urine, ankle swelling, or unusual mood changes
Maintain adequate protein and calorie intake for benefit
Inform clinician of pregnancy plans; effective contraception needed in women
Keep follow-up appointments for blood tests
pk: Serum nandrolone peaks within 24-48 hours, sustained release over days
Depot elimination ~6-12 days; effective dosing interval 1-4 weeks
Therapeutic effect for ~1-4 weeks per injection
20-25°C (68-77°F); protect from light; do not freeze
pearls: Long-acting depot ester allows infrequent dosing (weekly to monthly)
Widely misused as a performance-enhancing drug; subject to anti-doping prohibition
Virilizing effects in women may be irreversible - lowest effective dose and early discontinuation if signs appear
Largely superseded by erythropoiesis-stimulating agents for renal anemia
Lowers HDL cholesterol and may raise cardiovascular risk with long-term use
missed: If a scheduled injection is missed, administer it as soon as possible and resume the regular schedule; do not give two doses close together. Reschedule with the clinician if significantly delayed.
overdose: Acute overdose is unlikely with depot dosing; excessive or prolonged use leads to virilization, fluid retention, polycythemia, hepatic dysfunction, and adverse lipid/cardiovascular effects. Management is discontinuation and supportive care; treat polycythemia, edema, and hepatic injury as indicated.
